about_the_game:
• Step into the Old Future

Frutigeropolis presents a future where architecture is clean, inspiring and always in harmony with nature. This is a city where open, breathable spaces invite you to wander and reflect.

  • Discover the City

Explore environments crafted to feel like stepping into a memory. The environment itself tells a story, encouraging slow exploration and quiet discovery. Uncover hidden secrets, solve light puzzles, and find collectables as you slowly immerse yourself in a world shaped by the soul of Frutiger.

  • Visit My Personally Crafted Environments

Explore iconic pieces I’ve created and shared before, now fully rebuilt and brought to life within the game. Alongside these, discover exclusive new environments made especially for this journey. Much more awaits your discovery.

  • Enjoy the Ambience

From the meticulously designed environments to the immersive soundtrack, every element is built to create a calming and memorable experience.

name: Frutigeropolis: The Promised City

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / Radeon RX Vega 56 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: Playable at Low/Medium settings in Full HD (1080p), targeting 30 FPS or higher. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel i7-9750H / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 / Radeon RX 5600 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: Playable at Recommended settings in Full HD (1080p), targeting 60 FPS or higher. Performance may vary in complex scenes. SSD recommended.

short_description: Step into a serene, surreal city of the old future. Explore environments shaped by the soul of Frutiger design. Slow down inside a world built to be remembered.
